Last month we sent 412 reminders for our own invoices. We wrote none of them by hand.

When we started Fixturely, we were two freelancers who hated the follow-up email. You know the one. The invoice is ten days late, you open a blank message, and you spend twenty minutes trying to sound friendly and firm at once.

So we built the thing we wanted. You pick the days, Fixturely sends the reminder from your own address, and the reply lands next to the invoice.

It's not a collection tool, it's a calendar for money you already earned.

If you bill clients by the project, we'd like to hear how you chase payments today. Reply here or write to us from the site.
